content.title: About
content.content: The Light Ice Cream Bar with chocolate flavor is a low‑calorie dessert made from smooth dairy ice cream coated with a thin layer of dark chocolate. It is designed for those who want to enjoy a sweet treat without excess calories.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The bar contains about 120 kcal per 100 g, considerably less than traditional chocolate ice cream bars.
Reduced calories are achieved by using skimmed milk and sugar substitutes such as stevia.
The chocolate coating covers only 10 % of the bar’s volume, preserving a light texture.
The product is packaged in recyclable plastic suitable for secondary processing.
A small amount of vegetable oils is used to give a creamy structure without added butter.

items.title: Low Calorie Content
items.content: The bar fits well into weight‑control and diet plans.

items.title: Rich in Antioxidants
items.content: Dark chocolate provides flavonoids that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Source of Calcium
items.content: Skimmed milk contributes a modest amount of calcium beneficial for bones.

items.title: No Trans Fats
items.content: Creamy texture is achieved with trans‑fat‑free vegetable oils.

items.title: Supports Digestion
items.content: Added dietary fibers such as inulin aid normal bowel function.

items.title: Milk Protein Allergy
items.content: Contains dairy, which may trigger reactions in individuals allergic to lactose or casein.

items.title: Sugar Substitute Content
items.content: Some substitutes (e.g., sorbitol) can cause gastrointestinal discomfort if consumed in large amounts.

items.title: Caffeine Content
items.content: Dark chocolate includes a small amount of caffeine, which should be considered for children and caffeine‑sensitive individuals.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Keep the bar frozen and eat it straight from the freezer, allowing it to soften slightly (2‑3 minutes) before consumption. It works well as a standalone snack or paired with berries and low‑fat yogurt.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store at –18 °C or lower in a sealed package. Once opened, consume within 2‑3 days to maintain texture and flavor.
